notes.title: Steam Trading Cards
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now available for our game! In addition, patch 1.0.10 with a small number of bug fixes is also available for download.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Game Release!
notes.notes:
[b]Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?[/b] is now available!
We hope you enjoy it. And thanks to everyone who supported us and left comments for the demo and prequel.

notes.title: Release date announcement!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that we are planning to release [b]Is this Game Trying to Kill Me?[/b] on [b]November 13, 2024[/b]. You can also check out the new gameplay trailer.
